business_problem: Digital financial services firm Ally Financial (Ally) is using Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI Service to reduce manual tasks for its customer service associates, freeing up time for them to engage with customers. Ally is committed to delivering a seamless customer experience, and its associates are its human face.
solution_summary: Ally Financial built this solution on Azure OpenAI Service. Digital financial services firm Ally Financial (Ally) is using Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI Service to reduce manual tasks for its customer service associates, freeing up time for them to engage with customers. Azure OpenAI Service provides the generative AI model layer used for summarization, drafting, classification, or copilots in the workflow. After evaluating several options, Ally launched a collaborative project to develop a pilot built on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service. It sought to complete the pilot within six weeks and have the first use case in eight, an exceptionally short timeline for the banking sector. Messages, calls, or requests enter the existing workflow, Azure OpenAI Service classifies or summarizes them, and the reviewed output is surfaced to agents and frontline staff. The rollout also connects with call-center workflows so users can work inside existing operating processes.

business_outcome: Ally remains focused on its customers and creating and capturing value through innovation to better serve them. Its technology organization has the ambitious goal of launching a new project each month as it looks to harness more new uses for AI. Ally is also committed to protecting data privacy and security throughout its journey with AI, and it collaborates with Microsoft to advance that goal.
metrics: Now more than 700 associates have real-time access to summaries of tens of thousands of customer service calls per week and can edit them as needed.
Targeting a 50 percent reduction in post-call effort with conversational AI
The new solution has cut associates’ post-call effort by 30 percent—with the expectation of a 50 percent reduction—while capturing key details automatically.
Today, accuracy is over 85 percent, and Ally is still improving the solution.
architecture_clues: Human review remains in the loop to validate AI output quality.
